entries.067f499a85fb8444: Tokyo Kaikan Co., Ltd. was established in 1920, and in 1922 it opened the Honkan in Marunouchi. As of March 31, 2026, it had 480 employees.

entries.78503e513ef82b8f: This is a single-segment business that operates banquet halls, wedding venues and restaurants, and sells Western-style confectionery and other products. Centered on the Main Building (Honkan) in Marunouchi, it provides banquet, wedding and dining services at each sales office, including contracted management. Revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥16,259 million, broken down by division into banquets at ¥11,561 million, dining at ¥3,548 million, and shops and other at ¥1,150 million.

entries.9014c4df0fd24b68: As one of the competitive advantages supporting its brand, it cites the culinary techniques and recipes it has cultivated since its founding, and the hospitality and service suited to a refined space, together with a corporate culture in which frontline staff have autonomously refined, passed down and developed these skills.

entries.f991e2b383b462f7: Its new medium-term management plan for fiscal years 2026 to 2028 aims to strengthen its organizational foundation, make strategic investments in human capital and facilities, and improve brand strength. It also cites as challenges maximizing corporate value by building an appropriate pricing system based on a high value-added strategy, and improving productivity and efficiency through the use of technological innovation such as AI. Its long-term vision is for the company to remain a special place in people's lives that will be loved for 'the next 100 years.'
